title: Vendor invoices and remittance records
definition: The invoices raised by a vendor and the corresponding remittance records, showing what was billed, what was paid and when. They are requested where a supplier's invoices are being tested against the goods or services actually delivered, and they establish the billing relationship independently of the payer.
evidence_to_cite: the invoices, with the vendor and the period
the remittance records, cited by their own source id
the reconciliation between invoiced and paid amounts

sources.citation: Third-party billing records used in the assessment of trade, summarised in the FinCrime regulatory index.
